_comment: Landed rows whose capacity is still outstanding, with the reason and what would close it.
EMPTIED 7 September 2026, and the mechanism kept. All seven entries left as ROWS rather
than as filled figures: each was tested against its admitting source -- the source on which
it passed the perimeter's company-confirmed, >=1 GWh bar -- and in every case that source
names the site and states no capacity. A row admitted on a scale limb its own admitting
source never met is a row that should not have landed, so the seven went back to
sources/batteries_candidates.json rather than sitting here as a permanent shortfall.
THE FILE STAYS BECAUSE THE QUESTION RECURS. report_candidate_gaps.py prints whatever is
here on every build and drops an entry the moment its row gets a figure, so the next row
that lands with a capacity gap has somewhere to be counted instead of being carried in
